en.title: Indigo Night and the Promise to Cross the Sky
en.premise: My memories begin to stir with the discovery of a single sepia photograph hidden within a dusty old wooden box. It is a record of a promise—one tied to a 'flying ship' that once visited this town, and a young man who vanished on the night of a festival. Through the seasons gone by and letters that never arrived, the time that had stood still for me begins to move once more.

zh.title: 蓝色的夜晚与跨越天空的约定
zh.premise: 从在落满灰尘的旧木箱中发现一张深褐色照片开始，我的记忆重新启动了。那是关于曾经出现在这座小镇的“飞空船”，以及在祭典之夜消失的一名青年之间，一段约定的记录。逝去的季节与未能送达的信件，正静静地拨动我那停滞不前的时间。
